verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents program-level limits, approval stages for growth, or a process for raising limits. The pack covers account opening, KYC, a pre-launch readiness checklist, transfers and account locking, none of which addresses this story. The axis applies to a banking-as-a-service platform, so absence of evidence is "none".

support.subject: As a founder, growth doesn't hit invisible walls — program-level limits, approval stages, and the path to raising them are documented rather than discovered in an email from the bank
